name: Jamming Suite
description: Swift action: choose one target starship within 6 squares (starship scale). The target takes a -4 (starfighter) or -2 (space transport) penalty on Use Computer checks for communications or sensors, and the same penalty applies to its fire control (which cannot reduce its Intelligence modifier on attack rolls below +0). Effective only against small craft and space transports; the target's system operator may oppose it with a Use Computer check.
effect: Swift action: choose one target starship within 6 squares (starship scale). legacy.description: Electronic countermeasures to disrupt enemy sensors and targeting.

name: Jamming Array
description: Affects all enemy starships within 6 squares regardless of size: -6 (starfighters), -4 (space transports) or -2 (capital ships) on Use Computer checks for communications or sensors and on fire control (not below a +0 Intelligence modifier). A system operator may oppose it with a Use Computer check.
